title: Ivo and the Wolf
author: Zephyrine Reyes
blurb: Ines Winterbourne, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
